reason: SpellContext gains performed_actions_this_way, the player actions an instruction of the resolving chain performed, so a later "if you search your library this way" gate reads its own chain's search. It is serialized inside the stack's and a parked continuation's ResolvedAbility, defaulted and omitted when empty, so an older peer reading a newer state drops the mark and would skip a printed shuffle after a parked library search. Full-game peers and P2P move in lockstep; no lobby carrier names it.
